messages:
emma.k: Customer (AcmeCorp) just escalated — huge latency spikes and intermittent 504s since 03:12 UTC. They say traffic is being routed to eu-west-1 even though their app region is us-west-2.

emma.k: Quote from customer: "We started seeing tail latency jump to 2-3s then a bunch of 504s. Tracing shows nodes in EU. We never changed our region."

raj.s: putting this on the urgency ladder. Do we have recent routing changes or a rollout that could affect probe mapping?

maria_ops: I see a probe healthcheck flurry from 03:11:50 — some heartbeats reported as DOWN from the us-west-2 probe fleet, then quick flaps to OK. Could be false negatives triggering failover to EU.

support-bot: Incident autogenerated: routing-failover-detected (ID: INC-20260317-71). Notified eng-sre and oncall.

tim_oncall: i'm on it. pulling probe logs now. Can someone post minimal repro (customer request + curl) if they provided?

emma.k: Customer sent this repro curl: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACMExxx' \
  -H 'X-Region: us-west-2' \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```
They also attached a trace header showing upstream host: inference-eu-west-1-03.redwood.internal

raj.s: that's consistent with failover. Preliminary hypothesis: probe false negative in us-west-2 triggered smart-routing fallback policy, routing traffic to eu variant. Need to check heartbeat thresholds and TTLs for us-west-2 agents.

maria_ops: logs from probe-controller (excerpt):
```
[03:11:49] probe-usw2-12 heartbeat=OK seq=482
[03:11:50] probe-usw2-07 heartbeat=TIMEOUT seq=483 latency_ms=5200
[03:11:50] probe-usw2-09 heartbeat=TIMEOUT seq=483 latency_ms=5100
[03:11:51] probe-usw2-12 heartbeat=OK seq=484
[03:11:51] routing-eval: region_usw2_score=0.42 region_euw_score=0.88 -> selected=euw
```
small window of TIMEOUTs caused score to dip below threshold.

tim_oncall: can we confirm whether we have an autosuppress or debounce configured? If debounce too aggressive, single TTLs cause routing flip.

maria_ops: current config: heartbeats considered DOWN after 2 consecutive timeouts within 5s window, evaluation every 1s. Debounce only 3s. Seems tight under transient GC pauses on probe hosts.

raj.s: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) temporarily increase debounce to 10s for us-west-2 probes, 2) pin AcmeCorp to us-west-2 via customer routing override, 3) roll back any recent probe agent update. Thoughts?

emma.k: Customer asked for quick mitigation — they want traffic back to us-west-2 now. I can apply pin if ops approves.

maria_ops: I can apply routing override for the tenant and bump debounce now. Doing change in 2 mins and watching.

support-bot: Change executed: routing_override applied for tenant=AcmeCorp -> region=us-west-2 (by maria_ops). Debounce increased to 10s for probe-group=us-west-2.

tim_oncall: watching traces. If latency returns to normal, we can keep override and schedule proper fix. Also need to check whether probe agents had a kernel update / CPU steal at 03:10-03:12.

maria_ops: After override: traces show upstream host inference-usw2-15.redwood.internal. Latency dropping back to ~120ms. Customer confirms fewer 504s.

emma.k: Customer on the line says things look normal now. They want RCA and prevent recurrence.

raj.s: RCA next steps: collect probe agent metrics (GC, CPU steal), verify rollout history for probe-controller and probe agents, re-evaluate health scoring thresholds, add jitter-resistant aggregation (percentile-based) so single timeouts don't collapse score.

tim_oncall: i'll file a follow-up ticket to eng-runtime/serving: increase probe debounce, add 90th percentile window, and add metrics alert for probe flaps. TAGGING eng-sre and eng-runtime.

maria_ops: logging local evidence to INC-20260317-71. will attach agent logs and controller eval history.

emma.k: Thanks all — i'll update customer with mitigation and ETA for RCA. :white_check_mark:
